review_method: Visual inspection of saved physical PNGs and weak-light three-panel figure; independent of display observation

unwarmed_bright.observations: Strong green cast; source is unsuitable as normal white-paper optical acceptance
unwarmed_bright.user_display_observation: User did not notice the display color

warmed_bright.observations: Center appears gray-white; cyan/green cast and noise remain near edges

warmed_dark.observations: Gamma increases visible brightness; cyan/green cast and noise are visible and texture is indistinct
warmed_dark.user_display_observation: User corrected display observation: only a slight green tint, much less than saved figure; user suspects lighting, root cause not verified

display_capture_relationship: gamma_capture HDMI uses camera_preview: ongoing live frames sampled every fourth pixel and row; triplet exports freeze an earlier full frame. These are different times and grids, not a direct HDMI-versus-PNG pixel comparison.
limits: Waiting two seconds after camera/DDR readiness was added and verified. Changes across captures are not a controlled proof of startup white-balance as the root cause. Exact digital outputs and brightness changes do not prove color fidelity, recovered detail, temporal noise reduction or optical accuracy.
